concerns.text: The plan does not explicitly designate a Single Source of Truth (SSoT) artifact as required by Constitution Principle IV. While it mentions a “Single Source of Truth” table, it does not name a concrete file (e.g., spec.md or data-model.md) as the SSoT, which may be interpreted as a missing SSoT designation.

The plan references most contracts but never mentions validation against `contracts/delta_metrics.schema.yaml`, even though this schema is defined and required for the delta fields used in SC‑001. Adding an explicit validation step would close the gap.
